name: MegaDrive Buddies
tagline: Mega Drive characters who pace your desktop and square up when they meet.
credit: Sprites from Streets of Rage, Sonic the Hedgehog, Ristar, Fatal Fury 2, Earthworm Jim, Pulseman, ToeJam & Earl, World of Illusion, Moonwalker, Rocket Knight Adventures, Art of Fighting, Street Fighter II, Shinobi III, X-Men 2, Comix Zone and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles — Sega, SNK, Capcom, Konami, Interplay and others.
